bio_am: Ծնած է Լոռու Սանահին գիւղը՝ 1863-ին։ Խանասորի արշաւանքի հրամանատարներէն (1897), մահացած է Փարիզի մօտ՝ 1925-ին։
bio_en: Prince Hovsep Arghutian, known as Ishkhan and as 'Ishkhan of Khanasor', was born in 1863 in the village of Sanahin in Lori and graduated from the Nersisian school in Tiflis. In 1890 he went with Simon Zavarian to work as a teacher in Trabzon; arrested by the Turks as revolutionaries, the two were later exiled by the Caucasian authorities to the Kishinev area. In 1892 he became a teacher in Tabriz under Hovnan Davtian, in 1894 took an arms band to Van, where Peto and Vardan were working, and in 1895 returned to Tabriz to strengthen the arms workshop. In July 1897 he was one of the two commanders of the Khanasor expedition ('Vardan on the right, Ishkhan on the left'); on his return he was arrested by the Persians, held two months in chains, then a year and a half in Tiflis's Metekh prison, and exiled to Astrakhan province. In the First World War he led volunteers, later worked for refugees and organised the Constituent Assembly elections in Kars province; he died in Chaville near Paris on 15 October 1925.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Different person from Vana Ishkhan (Nikol Poghosian). Husband of Satenik Arghutian (#531).
